usage: Accord de matières : Façade de village
prompt:
A designer's material composition titled in spirit « Façade de village »: real samples of Peinture à la chaux, Châtaignier, Terre cuite émaillée arranged together as an interior architect's still life, in the proportion Chaux en façade · bois aux menuiseries · terre cuite au pied du mur. Mood: Maison de village rénovée dans les règles.
Editorial still-life photograph for an interior design magazine, 85 mm lens, close framing where the material fills most of the frame, soft raking daylight from the side that reveals the texture, natural depth of field, true colour, no blown highlights.
LOCKS: no brand, no logo, no label, no text, no people.
